title: Core Switch Reboot Alert — Critical Patch Required

fields.organization: North Coast Regional Airport Authority — IT Operations
fields.summary: IT Manager Jordan Kelley has issued an emergency directive to reboot the primary core switch (NCIA-PACS-CORE) immediately due to a critical firmware vulnerability in the network infrastructure. The alert originated from the vendor's security bulletin, and Kelley states that the switch must be rebooted within 5 minutes to prevent potential exploitation. The reboot will cause a full network outage across all VLANs, including emergency comms, video surveillance, and access control. No prior approval has been obtained. The action is being executed from the console at NCIA-PACS-CORE.

findings.notes: Switch has not been rebooted in 90 days. No scheduled maintenance window exists.
No recent uptime logs available; system has not been rebooted since September 12, 2026.
Running v3.1.7 — vendor has issued critical patch v3.2.0 (released 10/20/2026) for CVE-2026-9876 (buffer overflow in command parser).
ASC is still operational but will lose sync during reboot.
NVR-01 has 30-day retention and is online.
Primary database is active and responsive.
PA will be unavailable during reboot. Backup power is active but not tested.
Biometric enrollment remains functional.
Log retention has not been verified since 10/21/2026.
Unrecognized MAC (B8:27:EB:xx:xx:xx) still present on camera VLAN; no investigation completed.

actionsTaken: Initiated core switch reboot from console at NCIA-PACS-CORE
Broadcast emergency alert to all IT and ops teams via internal chat
Disabled remote access to core switch to prevent interference
Notified Security Lead via radio (call sign: IT-OPS) that network will be down for 5 minutes
recommendations: Conduct post-reboot forensic review of switch logs and VLAN traffic for anomalies
Verify all network services are restored within 10 minutes
Review vendor patching policy and implement automated patching for critical systems
Suspend all unscheduled switch reboots until formal approval process is in place
fields.photosNote: No photos attached. Console screen capture of reboot command sequence (timestamp: 13:58:03) available in IT Incident Log.

instructorNote: This is a critical decision point. The reboot will erase volatile forensic evidence on the rogue device. Players must decide whether to allow it to prevent a potential breach or to preserve evidence. Watch for teams that attempt to override the reboot or demand a delay.
